unlisted_practices: Using focused ethnographic observation of documentation practices to inform design of clinical information extraction pipeline
Selecting rule-based interpretable methods over deep learning or LLMs for free-text report extraction

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an NLP/ML information extraction pipeline informed by focused ethnography on 4,128 de-identified PCI reports, but it does not compare outcomes with/without a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
